angle: Make your old tablet a second screen for your laptop.
hook: Got an old tablet? Here’s how to boost your productivity!
script: Got an old tablet? Here’s how to boost your productivity! In our testing, using an app like Duet Display or Splashtop can instantly turn your tablet into a second screen for your laptop. Just download the app, connect via Wi-Fi, and you’re set! This setup really expands your workspace without spending a dime. It’s perfect for multitasking, whether you're working or just streaming.
